newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe annual inflation seen at 12 pct by 1998.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe annual inflation seen at 12 pct by 1998.

text.p: Zimbabwe's annual inflation is expected to fall to 16.5 percent by June 1998 before falling to 12 percent by the end of 1998 from 21.4 percent in June 1997, Finance Minister Herbert Murerwa said on Thursday.
In his budget speech, Murerwa said he expected interest rates, which Zimbabwean industrialists say are punitively high, to come down in tandem with inflation.
"We expect to exact a downward pressure on inflation to 16.5 percent by the end of June 1998 and to bring it down further to 12 percent at the end of the year," he said.
